This EDP is for both men and women and comes in a solid glass bottle and handcrafted wooden textured cap. has great performance, massive, exclusive, simply charismatic, powerful, compelling and a compliments galore. A very prominent oud note melds with the incense, along with some amber, woody notes, &amp; resinous notes. Long lasting woody-oriental frgrance with some quality projection and longevity. One of our finest EDPs specially designed bottles for a perfect gift to your beloved.

TOP NOTES: cinnamon, pepper HEART NOTES: tobacco leaf, incense, osmanthus , labdanum BASE NOTES: vanilla, cedar, musk , cypriol oil , vetiver, iso e super Supreme Gold is an opulent fragrance that exudes timeless elegance and luxury. The top notes of cinnamon and pepper create a warm, spicy opening, leading into a rich heart of tobacco leaf, incense, and osmanthus, enhanced by the deep resinous scent of labdanum. The base notes anchor the fragrance with a sensual blend of vanilla, cedar, and musk, enriched with the earthy depth of cypriol oil, vetiver, and the unique allure of Iso E Super. Supreme Gold is a sophisticated scent, perfect for those who appreciate the finer things in life.

Top Notes: sage, sea salt Heart Notes : grapefruit ,ambrette Base Note: seaweed Autobiography salty breeze. Embark on a sensory voyage with our latest men’s fragrance. A revitalizing blend of citrus and salt opens the experience, merging sage and sea salt for a crisp, invigorating top note. The heart unveils a lively fusion of grapefruit and ambrette, while a base of seaweed lends a distinctive, earthy depth. Capturing the essence of the sea, this fragrance is a celebration of freedom and adventure.

TOP NOTES:-GRAPEFRUIT,BERGAMOT,ORANGE,BASIL HEART NOTES:-JASMINE,ORANGE BASE NOTES:-CARAMEL,TONKA BEAN,VANILLA,MUSK,SANDALWOOD Discover Voux Zeste A dazzling burst of citrus awakens your senses with grapefruit, bergamot, and orange, kissed by aromatic basil. The heart blooms with the elegance of jasmine and orange blossom, while a warm, seductive base of caramel, tonka bean, vanilla, musk, and sandalwood lingers like a whisper of luxury.
Top notes are Litchi, Rhubarb, Bergamot and Nutmeg; middle notes are Turkish Rose, Peony, Musk, Petalia and Vanilla; base notes are Cashmeran, Incense, Cedar and Haitian Vetiver.

Top notes : Lemon and Water Notes Middle notes : Rose and Sugar Base notes : Vanilla, Sugar, White Musk and Cedar. Vanilla and roses is a harmonious combination of freshness, sweetness, and florals. The citrusy and watery top notes provide an energetic opening, while the floral and sweet middle notes add a romantic and inviting character. The base notes of vanilla, sugar, white musk, and cedar contribute to the warmth and depth of the overall composition. This fragrance appears to be well-suited for daytime wear, especially during the spring and summer seasons, and may appeal to those who enjoy light and sweet scents.

Top notes : Cinnamon, Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Saffron, Nutmeg, Green Apple and White Pear. Middle notes : Patchouli and Jasmine. Base notes : Tobacco, Madagascar Vanilla, Amber, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, White Musk and Haitian Vetiver. WILD AND TOBACCO EMIR is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. An entrancing, wonderful, and warm fragrance for special occasions. A wonderfully creamy, sweet tobacco, cinnamon fragrance that is mysterious and pleasing. The bombastic sweetness of the scent is toned down a little by the slightly dirty, smoky oud note and a patchouli note that smells like damp dark chocolate.This fragrance will warm your bones in winter and the passion of anyone who picks up your scent.

Notes: Cardamom,Coffee,Nutmeg,Cinnamon YOU'RE DRUGGED is an Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. This aromatic and spicy perfume is deep &amp; well-aged with cinnamon, whiskey, and coffee. It’s elegant, sublime, and stylish. Sweet and scented with cardamom, sensual and intense, this fragrance evokes Turkish coffee to perfection. Cinnamon and nutmeg complete the dance of warm spices, and conclude it with a caramelized, vanilla.

Top note: Cognac Middle notes : Cinnamon, Tonka Bean and Oak Base notes : Praline, Vanilla and Sandalwood. A luxurious and indulgent fragrance that opens with the rich, boozy warmth of cognac, unfolds into a heart of spicy cinnamon, creamy tonka bean, and woody oak, and settles into a decadent base of sweet praline, smooth vanilla, and velvety sandalwood, creating a warm and sophisticated scent.

Top notes : Nutmeg Flower, Lavender, Cedar, Chamomile, Mandarin Orange, Hawthorn, Bergamot and Lemon Middle notes : Violet Leaf, Nutmeg, Cedar, Sandalwood, Carnation, Honeysuckle, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley Base notes : Leather, Vetiver, Musk, Amber, Patchouli and Tonka Bean. A timeless and elegant scent crafted for those who appreciate depth and sophistication. Top Notes: The fragrance opens with a fresh and invigorating blend of bergamot, lemon, and mandarin orange, accented by the herbal softness of lavender, chamomile, and nutmeg flower, while hints of hawthorn and cedar add a woody freshness. Heart Notes: At its core, the composition blooms with the green, earthy aroma of violet leaf and the spice of nutmeg, balanced by the creamy richness of sandalwood. Floral notes of carnation, honeysuckle, jasmine, and lily-of-the-valley lend a delicate, romantic touch. Base Notes: The scent concludes with a warm and sensual base of leather, vetiver, and musk, layered with the richness of amber, patchouli, and the sweet softness of tonka bean. This fragrance is the perfect blend of freshness, warmth, and sophistication, making it ideal for both day and evening wear.

Top notes :Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Cardamom and Grapefruit Middle note : Lavender Base notes : Licorice, Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli and Haitian Vetiver. A bold and captivating fragrance that opens with a spicy blend of nutmeg, cinnamon, and cardamom balanced by zesty grapefruit, transitions into an aromatic heart of lavender, and settles into a rich, sensual base of licorice, sandalwood, amber, patchouli, and smoky Haitian vetiver.

Top notes : Lavender, Mint and Bergamot Middle notes : Sour Cherry, Freesia and Jasmine Base notes : Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Cacao Pod, Caramel, Praline, Benzoin, Milk, Sandalwood, Leather and Cedar. A delectable and captivating fragrance that begins with the refreshing brightness of lavender, mint, and bergamot, unfolds into a heart of luscious sour cherry, delicate freesia, and elegant jasmine, and concludes with a rich, gourmand base of tonka bean, vanilla, cacao pod, caramel, praline, benzoin, milk, and warm notes of sandalwood, leather, and cedar.

Top notes : Sicilian Lemon, Black Currant, Bergamot and Spicy Notes. Middle notes : Fruity Notes, Patchouli Leaf and Water Jasmine. Base notes : Cedar, Leather, Sandalwood, Vanilla, White Musk and Moss. CEDRAT ESSENCE is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. opens up with a very sharp, vibrant citrusy, and fruity blast. A timeless citrus woody composition that will never go out of style. It quickly gets spicy, woodsy plus a strong manly smell with hints of sweetness. Gorgeously blended and all-season-appropriate extrait de perfume that will leave a bold statement wherever you go. CEDRAT ESSENCE EMIR is remarkably versatile and enjoyable - The one to reach for when you can only reach for one.

Top notes : Cherry, Cinnamon, Sicilian Lemon and Nutmeg. Middle notes : Coca-Cola, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Orange Blossom. Base notes : Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Benzoin and Labdanum. Step into a world of effervescent nostalgia with Cherry Cola, a fragrance that combines the sweetness of cherries with the zesty sparkle of cola. From the lively top notes to the heart of cola nostalgia and the comforting base, this scent promises a delightful olfactory journey.Cherry Cola is more than a fragrance; it's a journey into the playful and comforting world of a classic beverage. From the spirited top notes to the nostalgic heart and the comforting base, each note is meticulously chosen to create a scent that resonates with joy and effervescence. Immerse yourself in the delightful world of Cherry Cola and let it be a source of aromatic delight and fond memories.

Top notes :Saffron, Ginger, Sicilian Mandarin and Sicilian Bergamot. Middle notes : Amberwood, Moroccan Rose, Egyptian Jasmine and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf. Base notes: Madagascar Vanilla, White Musk, Sandalwood and Oakmoss. SUPER CRUSH is an Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. It is a spicy-woody amber floral fragrance with some lovely notes of rose and jasmine spiced with saffron and ginger. Deep musk, amber wood, and citrus notes with a nice creamy sandalwood and vanilla drydown. The opening hits you with amber wood, jasmine, and vanilla, with citrus notes in the background. The perfect proportions of sweet musk and creamy, woodsy vanilla prolong the sophistication, placing SUPER CRUSH in the firmament of sweet, dry, spicy floral oriental fragrance.

Top notes : Calabrian bergamot and Italian Orange Middle notes : Agarwood (Oud), Amyris and Coriander Base notes : Leather, Atlas Cedar, Sandalwood, Musk and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf. This bold and sophisticated fragrance opens with the fresh, zesty brightness of Calabrian bergamot and Italian orange, creating an uplifting and energizing introduction. As the scent develops, the heart reveals a complex blend of rich agarwood (oud), smooth amyris, and aromatic coriander, adding depth and an intriguing, spicy warmth. The fragrance then settles into a luxurious base of leather, Atlas cedar, and sandalwood, offering a refined, woody richness, while musk and Indonesian patchouli leaf provide an earthy, sensual finish. Together, these elements create a powerful and elegant scent, perfect for those who appreciate a captivating, multifaceted fragrance.

Top notes :Tangerine, Bergamot and Grapefruit Middle notes : Damask Rose and Black Currant Base notes : Patchouli, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Labdanum and Musk. This elegant fragrance opens with a vibrant and refreshing burst of tangerine, bergamot, and grapefruit, creating an uplifting citrusy top that sparks the senses. The heart blooms with the timeless beauty of Damask rose, complemented by the deep, fruity richness of black currant, adding a layer of sophistication and warmth. As the scent settles, a luxurious base of patchouli, sandalwood, and vanilla creates a smooth, earthy foundation, while labdanum and musk lend a sensual, resinous depth. Together, these notes form a well-rounded, captivating fragrance that balances bright freshness with rich, comforting warmth. &nbsp;

Top notes : Pear, Lavender, Mint, Bergamot and Lemon. Middle notes : Cinnamon, Clary Sage and Caraway. Base notes : Black Vanilla Husk, Amber, Patchouli and Cedar. Introducing Atomise Intensive Men, a fragrance that embodies power, sophistication, and timeless allure. Let the carefully curated notes take you on a journey of invigorating freshness, spicy intrigue, and a warm, lasting embrace. it's a statement of confidence and sophistication. From the invigorating top notes to the spicy heart and the warm, lingering base, each element is meticulously crafted to create a scent that resonates with strength and allure. Unleash your intensity and make an impression that lasts with Atomise Intensive Men.

Top notes : Passionfruit, Peach, Pear, Raspberry, Cassis and Sand Middle note : Lily-of-the-Valley Base notes : Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Patchouli and Heliotrope. This enchanting fragrance opens with a delightful burst of passionfruit, peach, pear, raspberry, and cassis, blended with a touch of sand, creating a sweet, fruity, and slightly exotic introduction. The heart unveils the soft, delicate floral scent of lily-of-the-valley, adding a fresh and airy quality that perfectly balances the fruity top notes. As the fragrance settles, a warm and sensual base of musk, sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli, and heliotrope emerges, enveloping the wearer in a creamy, earthy, and slightly powdery depth. Together, these notes create a beautifully harmonious scent, offering a perfect mix of freshness, sweetness, and warmth.

Top notes : Mandarin Orange, Pineapple, Orange and Bergamot Middle notes : Ozonic notes, Violet, Amber, Jasmine and Rose Base notes : Musk, Sandalwood, Birch and Agarwood (Oud). This vibrant fragrance opens with a zesty and tropical blend of mandarin orange, pineapple, orange, and bergamot, creating a refreshing and uplifting burst of citrus. The heart reveals a beautifully balanced mix of ozonic notes, violet, amber, jasmine, and rose, adding a floral and airy touch that enhances the freshness of the top notes with a soft, romantic warmth. As the scent settles, the base unveils the deep, earthy richness of musk, sandalwood, birch, and agarwood (oud), lending a smoky, woody, and sensual depth to the fragrance. Together, these notes create a sophisticated and dynamic scent that effortlessly transitions from fresh and fruity to rich and alluring.

Tobacco ,Tobacco Leaf, Honey, Smoke, Plum ,Oriental notes, Amber, White Tobacco, Peach, Citruses A captivating blend of tobacco and tobacco leaf, enriched with the golden sweetness of honey and a touch of warm smoke. Juicy notes of plum, peach, and zesty citruses add a vibrant burst of freshness. Oriental notes and amber create an alluring depth, while the delicate sweetness of white tobacco lingers for a sophisticated finish. Perfect for those who desire a bold yet refined scent. &nbsp;

Top notes : Saffron, Juniper Berries and Chinese Grapefruit. Middle notes : Leather and Black Violet. Base notes are Raspberry, Cashmeran and Vetiver. Introducing a captivating fragrance that unfolds in layers, weaving together a rich tapestry of notes to create an intriguing and sophisticated olfactory experience: Top Notes: Saffron, Juniper Berries, Chinese Grapefruit Embark on a sensory journey with the opulent and spicy notes of Saffron, blended seamlessly with the crisp and zesty accords of Juniper Berries and Chinese Grapefruit. This invigorating top layer sets the stage for an enchanting olfactory adventure. Middle Notes: Leather, Black Violet As the fragrance evolves, the heart reveals a luxurious combination of Leather and Black Violet. The smooth and sensual quality of Leather intertwines with the dark and velvety essence of Black Violet, creating an alluring and sophisticated bouquet. Base Notes: Raspberry, Cashmeran, Vetiver The final act unfolds with a warm and comforting base. Raspberry adds a sweet and fruity touch, while Cashmeran contributes a soft and musky character, enhancing the overall depth. Vetiver, with its earthy and woody notes, grounds the fragrance, leaving a lasting and memorable trail.

Top: Cypress, bergamot Middle: Cedar wood, amber, labdanum, caramel Base: Vetiver, musk, jasmine A walk on the dirt' is a balanced combination of refreshing top notes, a warm and sweet heart, and a sensual, earthy base. It could be perceived as versatile, suitable for both daytime and evening wear, and may appeal to those who appreciate a harmonious blend of woody, resinous, and floral elements in their fragrances.

Top notes : Marshmallow, Honey, Cassis, Coconut and Bergamot Middle notes : Caramel, Vanilla, Pear, Jasmine and Peach. Base notes : White Musk, Orange Blossom, Raspberry and Violet. Forbidden Sugar is a fragrance that beckons to the senses, inviting you to indulge in its irresistible sweetness while hinting at the forbidden pleasures that lie within. It is a scent of seduction and allure, daring you to succumb to its irresistible charm.
Top notes are Caramel, Tobacco, Red Berries and Bitter Orange; middle notes are Tuberose, Lily and Orchid; base notes are Monoi Oil, Vanilla and Patchouli.

Top notes : Geranium, Black Currant and Sichuan Pepper. Middle notes : Leather and Rose Base notes : Vetiver and Cedar. Identity Rose &amp; Leather is a Leather fragrance for women and men. It opens with a leather note, which dominates until the dry down, bolstered by an inspired squeeze of blackcurrant juice. The rich, jammy rose note emerges early on and plays second fiddle to the smooth, nutty leather. The geranium adds a green, peppery edge to the rose, enhanced by the pepper note. A unique and surprising scent based on a rather abstract rose-leather accord

Notes :Agarwood (Oud). Fruity Notes Floral Notes Oriental notes Ambergris Woody Notes Olibanum Labdanum Blue oud is a harmonious blend of oriental richness, fruity vibrancy, floral elegance, and spicy allure. Perfect for those who seek a scent that evolves over time, offering a captivating journey of scent that is both luxurious and timeless. Immerse yourself in the allure of this complex and sophisticated olfactory experience, leaving an indelible trail of refinement and mystery.

Top notes : Pineapple and Hyacinth. Middle notes : Iris, Jasmine and Pink Pepper. Base notes : Musk, Vetiver, Amber, Vanilla and Patchouli. Indulge in the enchanting layers of our captivating fragrance, a symphony of notes that evokes sophistication and allure: Top Notes: Pineapple, Hyacinth Experience a burst of freshness with the tantalizing combination of sweet Pineapple and the floral brightness of Hyacinth. This dynamic top duo sets the stage for a lively and invigorating olfactory journey. Middle Notes: Iris, Jasmine, Pink Pepper As the fragrance unfolds, the heart reveals an intricate bouquet of floral and spicy notes. The elegance of Iris combines with the delicate allure of Jasmine, while the subtle spiciness of Pink Pepper adds a touch of vibrancy, creating a beautifully balanced and captivating core. Base Notes: Musk, Vetiver, Amber, Vanilla, Patchouli The final act unveils a warm and sensuous base that lingers, leaving an indelible impression. Musk contributes a soft and lingering quality, while Vetiver adds an earthy and woody depth. Amber and Vanilla bring a sweet and comforting warmth, and Patchouli provides a rich and earthy foundation, completing the fragrance with a captivating and enduring embrace. This fragrance is a testament to the artistry of scent, seamlessly blending fresh, floral, and warm notes. Perfect for those who appreciate a fragrance that evolves, inviting you to revel in the interplay of sophistication and allure. Elevate your presence with this enchanting scent that leaves an unforgettable trail of refinement and timeless beauty.

Top notes : Mandarin Orange and Californian Lemon. Middle notes :Neroli and Jasmine Sambac . Base notes : Cotton Candy and White Musk. VIBRANT ORANGE AND NEROLI is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. A unique fragrance with a realistic cotton candy dry down but stays close to the body so it never becomes overwhelming. The first blast of sweet musky lemon, citrus on a humid day as opposed to the usual bright sparkling clean one. After a minute, a warm sugar note steps forward along with airy jasmine. Sweet and lightening up that muskiness is just a smidge. A beautiful perfectly balanced blend of citrus, white florals, and gourmand sweetness. Whenever you need to change your mood- or keep the good times rolling- this is the one to reach for.

Top notes : Amalfi Lemon, Tagetes, Black Currant, Bergamot and African Orange Flower Middle notes : Violet, Cyclamen and Jasmine Base notes : Vetiver, Musk, Amber and Virginia Cedar. VIBRANT VETIVER DELIGHT EMIR is an Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This mix of the Parisian avant-garde and African culture shaped a unique and vibrant expression. This is very unique, a zingy, atypical-floral, vetiver tone fragrance. A vivacious blast of sunny citrus with just a pinch of spicy marigold makes a suitably dramatic entrance, leading to a brew of green bucchu, sheer and aqueous cyclamen, and sweet violet. The fragrance at center stage is the ever-bewitching vetiver, earthy and spicy, and smooth with sweet amber and warm musk until it becomes velvety and almost edible.

Top notes : Cumin, Mandarin Orange and Coriander. Middle notes : Tobacco, Leather and Labdanum. Base notes : Olibanum, Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud). Spicy tobacco unfolds like a journey, from the spicy and citrusy top notes, through the sophisticated and leathery heart, to the mystical and woody base. The combination of these notes promises a scent that is both alluring and distinctive, making a bold and memorable statement.

Top notes : Sicilian Orange, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian Lemon Middle note : Fruits Base notes : White Musk, Madagascar Vanilla and Amber. This vibrant fragrance opens with the invigorating brightness of Sicilian orange, Calabrian bergamot, and Sicilian lemon, offering a burst of zesty citrus freshness that awakens the senses. At the heart, a luscious fruit accord unfolds, adding a sweet and juicy depth that evokes the feeling of a sun-kissed orchard. The scent then transitions into a warm, sensual base of white musk, Madagascar vanilla, and amber, creating a soft, creamy, and slightly resinous foundation. Together, these notes craft a balanced, uplifting yet cozy fragrance that is both refreshing and comforting, perfect for day-to-night wear.

Notes: Spicy Notes, Sandalwood, Allspice, Patchouli, Basil This captivating fragrance opens with a bold blend of spicy notes, infused with the warm, aromatic intensity of allspice, creating a stimulating and rich introduction. At its heart, the earthy essence of sandalwood provides a smooth, creamy base, while the deep, musky undertones of patchouli add a mysterious allure. A hint of fresh basil adds a vibrant, green freshness, perfectly balancing the warmth of the spices. Together, these elements combine to form a complex, sensual scent that evokes both sophistication and intrigue, leaving a lasting impression.
Top notes are Basil, Incense and Fruits; middle notes are Vanilla and Woodsy Notes; base notes are Amber and Cambodian Oud.

Top notes : Agarwood (Oud), Saffron and Vanilla. Middle notes : Rose, Patchouli and Musk. Base notes :Sandalwood and Amber. Our fragrance invites you to immerse yourself in a world where luxury knows no bounds, and every essence is a testament to the artistry of scent. Explore the depth of your senses with our exclusive collection—a symphony of Agarwood, Saffron, Vanilla, Rose, Patchouli, Musk, Sandalwood, and Amber.

TOP NOTES:-BLOOD ORANGE,GRAPEFRUIT,MANGO,BLACKCURRANT HEART NOTES:-PEACH,PINEAPPLE,MELON BASE NOTES:-VIOLET,SUGAR,MUSK Step into a tropical paradise with Mango Jugoso, a perfume that celebrates the juiciness of life. This captivating fragrance is an irresistible blend of luscious fruits and soft musk, designed to leave a lasting impression wherever you go.

TOP NOTE – BLEND OF CARAMEL , BERGAMOTE , ORANGE MIDDLE NOTE – BLEND OF CHOCOLATE , COCOA ,BUTTER , COCONUT , BLACKCURRANT , PEACH BASE NOTE - BLEND OF VANILLA , MUSK , SANDAL WOOD Meet CHOCO CULT - a fragrance that feels like diving into a rich, chocolate fantasy. It opens with a sweet splash of caramel, orange, and bergamot, melts into a creamy heart of chocolate, coconut, and peach, and settles into a warm base of vanilla, musk, and sandalwood. Sweet, smooth, and unforgettable - this is the scent of guilty pleasure.

TOP NOTES:-BISCUIT HEART NOTES:-COCONUT,CREAM BASE NOTES:-VANILLA,SUGARY,TONKA BEAN Satisfy your sweet cravings with Creamy Biscuit, the latest indulgence from our Ministry of Gourmand series. This delectable fragrance begins with the cozy warmth of buttery biscuits, followed by a heart of creamy coconut, and finishes with the sweet allure of vanilla, sugar, and tonka bean. A scent so tempting, it feels like your favorite dessert captured in a bottle. Dive into the ultimate gourmand experience with Creamy Biscuit—a treat for every sweet soul.

TOP NOTES:- FRUITY,GOURMAND,RED FRUITS HEART NOTES:- MILKY,FRUITY,TOASTED BASE NOTES:- SWEET,FRUITY Indulge in the irresistible allure of a fruity cheesecake in fragrance form. A luscious symphony of sweet raspberries, ripe strawberries, creamy milk, decadent caramel, and velvety vanilla. From our Ministry of Gourmand series, this is pure dessert decadence-without the calories!

Top note : Lemon,Mandarin,Bergamot Heart notes : Apple,Watermelon,Caramel Base notes : Vanila,Coconut Coconut Lagoon offers a refreshing burst of citrus with lemon, mandarin, and bergamot, followed by a tropical blend of coconut water and sweet fruits like apple and watermelon. The fragrance is beautifully balanced with a soft sweetness from caramel and vanilla, creating an uplifting yet soothing vibe. It captures the essence of a tropical escape with a hint of indulgence, perfect for those who crave freshness with a touch of sweetness.

Top notes : Turkish Rose and Saffron. Middle note : Agarwood (Oud). Base notes : Sandalwood and Olibanum. Ministry of Oud - Strictly Oud is an Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. The Strictly Oud is a brilliant take on the classic rose/oud combo. It's quite refined, though full of the cheesy/barnyard notes. The Strictly Oud remains the mild woody rose skin scent during its long dry down. This little treasure starts off as a full-blooded oud should and then in the next hours the magic happens! Rose and amber spread their wings and take off on a journey. Ministry of Oud is one of our finest extrait de parfum specially designed bottles for a perfect gift to your beloved.

Top notes : Rose and Bergamot. Middle note : Patchouli. Base notes : Agarwood (Oud) and Amber. Introducing a timeless and captivating fragrance that seamlessly blends classic and exotic elements: Top Notes: Bergamot, Rose Open your olfactory senses with the uplifting and bright notes of Bergamot, offering a citrusy and zesty introduction. The delicate and romantic aroma of Rose adds a floral elegance, creating a harmonious and inviting top layer. Middle Note: Patchouli As the fragrance unfolds, the heart reveals the earthy and rich character of Patchouli. This note adds depth and complexity to the composition, grounding the scent with a touch of warmth and sophistication. Base Notes: Oud, Amber The final act of this olfactory symphony unveils a luxurious and alluring base. Oud, with its deep and resinous quality, provides an exotic and mystical touch. Amber contributes a warm and sweet facet, wrapping the fragrance in a sensuous and comforting embrace that lingers, leaving a lasting impression.

Top notes : Pink Pepper, Lemon and Sicilian Bergamot. Middle notes : Cedar, Angelica and Galbanum. Base notes : Sandalwood, Agarwood (Oud) and Musk. Oud Royal is a fragrance that exudes regality and refinement, capturing the essence of timeless elegance. From the lively opening to the complex heart and the enduring base, each note is a testament to the artistry of scent, creating an experience that is truly royal. Indulge in the opulence of Oud Royal and let its luxurious aura envelop you.

Top notes : Saffron, Nutmeg and Lavender. Middle note : Agarwood (Oud). Base notes: Patchouli and Musk. This fragrance is a masterpiece of contrasts, combining the freshness of Lavender with the richness of Agarwood and the warmth of Patchouli and Musk. Ideal for those who appreciate a blend that is both sophisticated and inviting, it invites you to indulge in a sensory journey that exudes refinement and timeless allure. Elevate your presence with this captivating scent, a true embodiment of luxurious elegance.

Top notes : Leather, Cinnamon and Cardamom. Middle notes : Myrrh, Tobacco, Atlas Cedar and Incense. Base notes : Thailand Oud, Cambodian Oud, Cypriol Oil and Patchouli. Ministry of Oud- Thailand Oud in Cairo is an Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. A very unique and excellent addition to theMinistry of oud line. This Oud successfully takes you on an olfactory journey through the depth and grandeur of the ancient Egyptian civilization. Oud and leather blend beautifully with tobacco, cinnamon, myrrh, and cypriol to create a perfect balance of salty animalistic tone and green spicy semi-sweet warmth.Thailand Oud in Cairo is one of the most mainstream crowd-pleasing types of woody Oriental scent from the Ministry of Oud line. The masculine-leaning perfume has moderate to strong projection and good longevity.

Top notes are Lemon, Lime and Bergamot. Middle notes are Rose de Mai, Fig, Jasmine and Ylang-Ylang. Base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Ambergris, Cinnamon, Sandalwood, Benzoin, Saffron, Oakmoss, Orris, Birch, Musk and Patchouli. Amber Oud is an Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Amber Oud is one of the most luxurious, royal and so smooth versions of oud. It is the soul and essence of oud and its ethereal, otherworldly beauty that is conveyed through its use in the highest reaches of society. The perfume opens with citrusy notes of bergamot and lime. The firmly floral heart showcases rose, lang, jasmine with a slight hint of fig. The perfume settles on a powdery base of oud surrounded by hints of saffron, oakmoss, patchouli, civet, cinnamon, sandalwood, and synthetic musk. Very regal and sophisticated perfume, the unisex perfume has moderate to strong projection and excellent longevity. One of our finest extrait de parfum is designed for men and women, a perfect way to establish your presence.
Top notes are Pineapple, Bergamot, Cucumber, Melon and Black Currant; middle notes are Patchouli, Jasmine, Basil and Sage; base notes are Woody Notes, Ambergris, Vanilla and Musk.
Top notes : Pink Pepper, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Lavender. Middle notes :Black Pepper, Cinnamon and Saffron. Base notes : Vanilla, Leather, Vetiver and Tobacco.

Top Notes: Grapefruit, Labdanum, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Saffron, Cypriol Oil Embark on a vibrant and aromatic adventure with the invigorating burst of Grapefruit, harmoniously blended with the resinous warmth of Labdanum.
